description: This file defines a custom exception class `LinkedAccountRequiredException` used within the loan product package of the Fineract project. It extends a core exception class indicating it is a specialized exception for domain rule violations related to linked accounts.

classes.name: LinkedAccountRequiredException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a linked account is required for a specific entity in the loan product context.

methods.name: LinkedAccountRequiredException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message key based on the entity and a default user message.
